purpose: Re-run the exact previously attempted EQPT MBO feature diagnostic with the published Fill/Cancel identity repair and unchanged threshold-free feature engine, without selecting a feature, window, threshold, strategy rule, or broker action.

request_surface.case_selection_reason: EQPT is the exact first case that stopped safely under the old five-field identity and the only case supported by the published aggregate classifier. No Ross action, transcript label, P&L, later price, or feature output selected the case.

preregistered_hypothesis: The exact EQPT request will normalize without an unmatched Fill, produce at least one complete causal feature snapshot under the published identity repair, and a second independent feature engine will reproduce the identical full snapshot-sequence digest.
success_requirements: the exact metadata quote passes both fixed ceilings before the time-series request
the sole exact MBO request completes on the first GitHub Actions attempt
the downloaded file is nonempty and matches the registered dataset and schema
the repaired translator uses the Cancel record payload for every matched Fill removal
the case yields at least one complete feature snapshot
the independent feature replay is exact
no feature value, threshold, label, raw record, credential, or temporary path is persisted
the raw DBN file is deleted before the sanitized aggregate report is finalized
failure_rule: If metadata preflight fails or exceeds either ceiling, make zero time-series requests. After the sole download begins, classify the first provider, file, parser, replay, or cleanup failure without retrying or changing the repair.

storage_and_licensing.raw_storage: Temporary GitHub runner directory only after separate execution authorization.
storage_and_licensing.persisted_output: Sanitized non-reconstructable counts, availability totals, exact-replay booleans, quote totals, and cryptographic digests.
storage_and_licensing.cleanup_rule: Delete the DBN file before finalizing the sanitized report and fail closed if the temporary directory is not empty.

prohibited_inputs_and_actions: trade P&L or later price outcome
threshold fitting, horizon selection, or case suppression
modifying the published Fill/Cancel repair or threshold-free feature engine
claiming single-venue Nasdaq depth is consolidated national Level 2
claim_boundary: This bundle is unarmed and cannot call Databento or spend credit.

A future EQPT pass would validate the repaired parser and frozen feature mechanics on this engineering case only; it would not establish predictive value, a profitable threshold, Ross-equivalent discretion, consolidated Level 2 coverage, execution quality, or profitability.
A future failure remains evidence and cannot be hidden by changing the identity, case, feature, or threshold.
